{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Build

on: [push, pull_request]

jobs:
  build:
    name: ${{ matrix.os }} ${{ matrix.cxx_compiler }} ${{ matrix.build_type }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}

    strategy:
      matrix:
        include:
          - os: ubuntu-22.04
            c_compiler: gcc-12
            cxx_compiler: g++-12
            build_type: Release

          - os: ubuntu-22.04
            c_compiler: clang-18
            cxx_compiler: clang++-18
            build_type: Release

          - os: ubuntu-22.04
            c_compiler: clang-19
            cxx_compiler: clang++-19
            build_type: Release

          - os: ubuntu-24.04
            c_compiler: gcc-13
            cxx_compiler: g++-13
            build_type: Release

          - os: ubuntu-24.04
            c_compiler: gcc-14
            cxx_compiler: g++-14
            build_type: Release

          - os: ubuntu-24.04
            c_compiler: clang-18
            cxx_compiler: clang++-18
            build_type: Release

          - os: ubuntu-24.04
            c_compiler: clang-19
            cxx_compiler: clang++-19
            build_type: Release

          - os: macos-15
            c_compiler: clang
            cxx_compiler: clang++
            build_type: Release

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install dependencies (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          set -euxo pipefail

          # Pick the correct Ubuntu codename for apt.llvm.org (jammy vs noble).
          LLVM_SUITE=""
          if [[ "${{ matrix.os }}" == "ubuntu-22.04" ]]; then
            LLVM_SUITE="jammy"
          elif [[ "${{ matrix.os }}" == "ubuntu-24.04" ]]; then
            LLVM_SUITE="noble"
          else
            echo "Unsupported Linux runner: ${{ matrix.os }}"
            exit 1
          fi

          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
            ca-certificates \
            gpg \
            software-properties-common \
            wget

          # Core deps
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
            re2c ninja-build libhiredis-dev redis-server

          # LLVM apt repo (for clang-18/19)
          if [[ "${{ matrix.cxx_compiler }}" == "clang++-18" || "${{ matrix.cxx_compiler }}" == "clang++-19" ]]; then
            sudo mkdir -p /etc/apt/keyrings
            wget -qO- https://apt.llvm.org/llvm-snapshot.gpg.key | sudo gpg --dearmor -o /etc/apt/keyrings/llvm.gpg

            if [[ "${{ matrix.cxx_compiler }}" == "clang++-18" ]]; then
              echo "deb [signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/llvm.gpg] http://apt.llvm.org/${LLVM_SUITE}/ llvm-toolchain-${LLVM_SUITE}-18 main" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/llvm.list >/dev/null
            fi
            if [[ "${{ matrix.cxx_compiler }}" == "clang++-19" ]]; then
              echo "deb [signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/llvm.gpg] http://apt.llvm.org/${LLVM_SUITE}/ llvm-toolchain-${LLVM_SUITE}-19 main" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/llvm.list >/dev/null
            fi

            sudo apt-get update
          fi

          # Toolchains
          if [[ "${{ matrix.cxx_compiler }}" == "clang++-18" ]]; then
            sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends clang-18
          fi
          if [[ "${{ matrix.cxx_compiler }}" == "clang++-19" ]]; then
            sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends clang-19
          fi
          if [[ "${{ matrix.cxx_compiler }}" == "g++-12" ]]; then
            sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends gcc-12 g++-12
          fi
          if [[ "${{ matrix.cxx_compiler }}" == "g++-13" ]]; then
            sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends gcc-13 g++-13
          fi
          if [[ "${{ matrix.cxx_compiler }}" == "g++-14" ]]; then
            sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends gcc-14 g++-14
          fi

      - name: Install dependencies (MacOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install re2c ninja redis hiredis

      - name: Cache Z3
        id: cache-z3
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ${{ github.workspace }}/z3-install
            ${{ github.workspace }}/z3-build
          key: z3-${{ matrix.os }}-${{ matrix.cxx_compiler }}-z3-4.15.4-${{ hashFiles('.github/workflows/build.yml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            z3-${{ matrix.os }}-${{ matrix.cxx_compiler }}-z3-4.15.4-

      - name: Set Z3 environment (cache hit)
        if: steps.cache-z3.outputs.cache-hit == 'true'
        run: |
          echo "Z3_PREFIX=${{ github.workspace }}/z3-install" >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"
          echo "Z3_LIBDIR=${{ github.workspace }}/z3-install/lib" >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"
          if [[ "${RUNNER_OS}" == "macOS" ]]; then
            echo "DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH=${{ github.workspace }}/z3-install/lib:${DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH-}" >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"
          else
            echo "LD_LIBRARY_PATH=${{ github.workspace }}/z3-install/lib:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH-}" >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"
          fi

      - name: Build Z3 (from source)
        if: steps.cache-z3.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        run: |
          set -euxo pipefail

          Z3_TAG="z3-4.15.4"
          Z3_SRC="${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/z3-src"
          Z3_BUILD="${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/z3-build"
          Z3_INSTALL="${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/z3-install"

          rm -rf "${Z3_SRC}" "${Z3_BUILD}" "${Z3_INSTALL}"
          git clone --depth 1 --branch "${Z3_TAG}" https://github.com/Z3Prover/z3.git "${Z3_SRC}"

          Z3_CMAKE_ARGS=(
            -G Ninja
            -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
            -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX="${Z3_INSTALL}"
            -DZ3_BUILD_TEST_EXECUTABLES=OFF
            -DZ3_BUILD_EXECUTABLE=OFF
            -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER="${CMAKE_C_COMPILER}"
            -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER="${CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER}"
          )

          cmake -S "${Z3_SRC}" -B "${Z3_BUILD}" "${Z3_CMAKE_ARGS[@]}"

          cmake --build "${Z3_BUILD}" --target install

          echo "Z3_PREFIX=${Z3_INSTALL}" >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"
          echo "Z3_LIBDIR=${Z3_INSTALL}/lib" >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"

          # Runtime loader hints (fallback if RPATH isn't sufficient on a runner).
          if [[ "${RUNNER_OS}" == "macOS" ]]; then
            echo "DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH=${Z3_INSTALL}/lib:${DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH-}" >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"
          else
            echo "LD_LIBRARY_PATH=${Z3_INSTALL}/lib:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH-}" >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"
          fi

      - name: Compile
        run: bash .github/scripts/build.sh

      - name: Run Tests
        run: ninja check
        working-directory: build

    env:
      CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE: ${{ matrix.build_type }}
      CMAKE_C_COMPILER: ${{ matrix.c_compiler }}
      CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER: ${{ matrix.cxx_compiler }}
#      CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS: "-fsanitize=address,undefined"
",
  "rationale": "The workflow builds Z3 from source on every run, which is a significant time cost. Evidence from experiment batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-a89d5fd8d30bc8cb-r2 (P-LIT-CONFIG-REUSE) demonstrates adding a dependency cache step (Maven packages) before the build. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern supports caching dependency downloads with lockfile/environment inputs. Here, Z3 is a fixed-version dependency (z3-4.15.4) built per compiler/OS matrix cell. Adding a cache step for the Z3 install and build directories, keyed by OS, C++ compiler, Z3 tag, and workflow file hash, avoids rebuilding Z3 on cache hits. The Build Z3 step is skipped on cache hit, and a separate step sets the required environment variables. This preserves all build/test coverage while eliminating redundant Z3 compilation.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-a89d5fd8d30bc8cb-r2", "pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE", "pattern:P-LIT-CONFIG-REUSE"]
}
